articles.headline: ‘Obsession’ One Year Later: Inde Navarrette and Curry Barker Dish on Memes, How Nikki Became More ‘Flirty’ and Their Wild Ride at TIFF
articles.summary: Navarrette and Curry Barker returned to TIFF to discuss Obsession a year after its premiere. She described her audition, contributions to Nikki’s characterization and growing interest in producing and directing.
articles.evidence: Original article reports the September 11 TIFF panel and directly quotes Navarrette on her audition, character decisions and professional plans. H1 headline, RSS pubDate and article datePublished were checked.
articles.accessNote: Full original publisher article readable via HTTP 200. Focus the summary on craft; no personal-life or meme details are needed.

articles.headline: Jaafar Jackson, Inde Navarrette and Ray Nicholson Among Variety’s 10 Actors to Watch for 2026
articles.summary: Variety named Navarrette to its 2026 class of 10 Actors to Watch, citing her work in Obsession and upcoming role in X-Men. The announcement schedules the group’s profiles and Newport Beach Film Festival celebration for October.
articles.evidence: Publisher's own selection announcement lists Navarrette by name and explains the career basis. Article schedules profiles for October 7 and an honors brunch for October 18; these remain future events as of September 15.
articles.accessNote: Full original publisher article readable via HTTP 200. Exact h1 and datePublished checked.

articles.headline: Inde Navarrette To Star In ‘The Waffle House Index’ Movie From Apple & Plan B
articles.summary: Deadline reports that Navarrette is attached to star in and executive produce The Waffle House Index. Apple Original Films acquired the package, with Plan B producing and Louis Paxton attached to direct.
articles.evidence: Article body explicitly reports both starring and executive-producer roles and names the studio, producer and attached director. Summary omits anonymous-source financial terms and speculative implications.
articles.accessNote: Full original publisher article readable via HTTP 200. Exact h1, RSS pubDate and article datePublished checked.

articles.headline: John Leguizamo, Inde Navarrette and James Ortiz Among Latino and Hispanic Stars Set for Honors at Critics Choice Celebración Ceremony
articles.summary: Navarrette was announced as the recipient of the Breakthrough Actress Award for film at the Critics Choice Association’s Celebración of Cinema & Television. The honor recognizes Obsession, with the ceremony scheduled for October 2.
articles.evidence: Article's Navarrette paragraph specifies the award and film. Opening section schedules the ceremony for October 2 in Beverly Hills; summary treats this as an announced honor rather than an already-held ceremony.

articles.headline: ‘Obsession’ & ‘Superman & Lois’ Star Inde Navarrette Set For Rollercoaster Thriller ‘Invertigo’ From ‘Fall’ Producers — EFM
articles.summary: Deadline announced Navarrette as the star of Invertigo, a thriller from producers Capstone and Tea Shop. Matthias Hoene is directing from a script by Kathy Charles and Billy O’Brien.
articles.evidence: Original casting report explicitly names Navarrette and includes direct comments from director Matthias Hoene and Capstone head Christian Mercuri about working with her. H1, RSS pubDate and datePublished all checked.
